# JWAT Enterprises Inc

> Small-business growth resource from JWAT Enterprises Inc: business funding, business credit, CRM and follow-up systems, AI call answering, and tax planning, with guides to vetted partners (ROK Financial, Nav, GoHighLevel, Upfirst, Novo).

- JWAT is not a lender, bank, or tax preparer and does not give financial advice. It may earn referral fees from partner links.
- Funding terms (credit minimums, amounts, speed) are as published by the partner on the date of each article and vary by lender.
